title: JFK Mansfield Eulogy A Piece of Each of Us Died This Week Magazine Nov 19 1967
conditionDescription: Single loose leaf (pages 7-8), not a complete magazine. Torn edges, missing pieces at the outer edge, fold lines and toning (pictured).
descriptionText:
Original leaf from THIS WEEK Magazine, November 19, 1967 - pages 7 and 8. Not a complete magazine.

- Page 8: "A Piece of Each of Us Died" by Rudolph Umland - Senator Mike Mansfield's Capitol rotunda eulogy for President John F. Kennedy, set as a poem ("And so she took a ring from her finger and placed it in his hands"), with a large JFK portrait. Published on the eve of the fourth anniversary of the assassination.
- Page 7: the end of a cruise-ship safety article - "Planning a Cruise? Do This Before You Sail", the Lakonia and Yarmouth Castle fires, SOLAS standards.

Condition: original 1967 newsprint. Torn and ragged edges with pieces missing at the outer edge, fold lines and toning. The eulogy text and the portrait are complete (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
